caseName: Central of Georgia Railway Co. v. Deloach
caseNameFull: Central of Georgia Railway Company, in Error v. Birdie V. Deloach
summary: In error to the Court of Appeals of the State of Georgia.
attorneys: Mr. T. M. Cunningham, Jr., for plaintiff in error., Mr. Edgar J. Oliver and Mr. Francis M. Oliver for defendant in error;

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment reversed with costs upon the authority of Pennsylvania Co. v. Donat, 239 U. S. 50; New York Central & Hudson River R. R. Co. v. Carr, 238 U. S. 260.
